utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look at the repair drive, but I need the details first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can bring it by later, but I need you to show me what’s wrong first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring it by when you can, and I’ll show you what’s wrong.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we need a clear plan for the repair drive and who is bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, who’s bringing the tools and who’s covering the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can take the tools if someone else is on supplies, but we should name both before we start so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed a few updates, but I’m here now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, no worries. Glad you’re here now, Noah, we can still sort out the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, let’s keep it simple and make sure we’ve got enough hands for it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the repair drive. I’ll spread the word and keep everyone on the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear. I’ll keep an ear out and let folks know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I will. I’ll keep it moving and make sure everyone hears the same plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive coming along?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Pretty well so far — we’ve got a few volunteers here and are keeping the work moving. Glad you made it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear. I can jump in and help keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Quinn. Let’s keep it simple: tell me what’s being fixed and when I should expect the next update.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. Just tell me what’s being repaired and when I should check back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the common stuff: a few loose screens, one dripping faucet, and a porch step that needs fixing. I can walk you through the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, walk me through the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, absolutely - I can help you get the word out on the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure - I can ask around and spread the word. Where should people drop off donations for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: People can drop donations at my porch on Maple Street, and I’ll make sure everything gets to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Rosa. I’ll be there and I can bring a few tools too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara. I’ll count on you for the tools, and I’ll make sure we’re ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I’ll be there with the tools and I’ll keep my word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the list started, but I need to know what Bo still needs for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I still need screws, a drill bit set, and maybe some wood glue.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve got it started: screws, a drill bit set, and maybe some wood glue. I’ll keep an eye out for the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s picking up this afternoon, and folks are saying the big stuff gets tackled first. I can swing by later and tell you what they’ve finished.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help. I’m curious what they get through first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep an ear out and let you know what they get done first. Usually the smaller fixes go quick, but I want to see what actually moves today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, I’m listening. What needs fixing on the repair drive, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly the broken cabinet hinges and the leaky sink under the hall bathroom. If you can point us to the right volunteer, I can make sure the school pickup time doesn’t clash.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Could you point me to the volunteer handling the hinges and sink, and I’ll make sure it doesn’t interfere with pickup time?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’m on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do. I’ll keep you posted if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can bring it up with folks and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik. I’ll check in with the other folks and keep the repair drive moving too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, I’ll keep bringing it up and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind on that, so you’ll have to remind me what changed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the total’s shifted a bit since last time. I can remind you of the new amount, and who it’s going to.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, remind me of the new amount and where it’s going.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I’ve got a few tools and I can bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, just let me know when you’re ready and I’ll help carry them over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the sign-up sheet and I’m lining up the first round of repairs now. Tell me which houses need the most help, and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The ones on Maple and 3rd are the worst off, especially the porch and roof. I’ll keep an eye out for the others too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and whether there are enough hands to get it done. If we can confirm the parts and schedule first, I’ll feel better.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can check the parts and line up a signup tonight so we know who’s in before we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds better. If the parts are confirmed and we know who’s helping, I’m comfortable moving ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s still the plan as far as I know. I just want to confirm the time before we head over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but I’m not going until you tell me the time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll meet you there and we’ll go over the repair list one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, I’ll join you there and stick to the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. I’ll bring the list, and we’ll work through it together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s been a good bit of movement on it. Did Cleo say what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Just the last bits, really — a few supplies still need sorting, but it’s moving along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to hear. Do you know what supplies they still need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to bring the list, but I may have left it on my kitchen table.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, I can jot down the list from memory and we can compare notes after.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara. If you jot it down, I’ll check my kitchen table and we can compare right after.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school if the timing works. What time is the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It starts at 3:30 after school.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work if I can get there right after school.
